NAME: Maze Sequencer
DESCRIPTION: Dual generative 8-step sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style), clock-synced to the Force transport (port of the Schwung 'Maze' tool for Ableton Move). Headless: control it from a Force MIDI track via CC, or from the web panel. Independent per-sequencer output MIDI channel (Seq 1/Seq 2). See README.md / CC-MAP.md.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: module directory (also where maze_seq.bin state persists)
